AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#314 @ 2f7789eca795d6fe7f895ae2b498435605feec01 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Full T4 audit (Opus lens) against the #610 contract at `d1e1732f`.
- **Range:** merge-base `c4963f87..2f7789e`, 3 commits, 22 files.
- **What I read:** `communityErrors.ts`, `communitySafetyApi.ts`, `SafetyMenu.tsx`, every call site, and the safety and moderation screens.
- Read-only and independent.

## Contract match: PASS
- **Endpoints and shapes match #610:**
  - `POST /community/moderation/reports` with `{ target_type: post|comment|message, target_id, reason }`; the backend's `REPORT_TARGET_TYPES` is the same set.
  - `GET /community/blocks`, `POST /community/blocks { user_id }`, `DELETE /community/blocks/:userId`, `GET /community/safety`.
  - Challenge comments are `communityMessage` rows, so reporting them as `comment` resolves on the backend.
- **Report on every surface the backend can report:**
  - posts: Space, Thread;
  - comments: Thread, Challenge;
  - DM messages: DM thread, header and each message.

  That is 6 `SafetyMenu` sites. DMs report as `message`, and the backend allows only the two participants.
- **No dead Block buttons:**
  - `SafetyMenu` returns null on the viewer's own content.
  - It hides Block when the author is `viewerCoachId`, which all 6 sites set to `client?.coach_id`.
  - If the backend's workspace coach ever differs from `client.coach_id`, the user gets the specific `community.block.workspace_coach` copy, not a silent failure.
- **Copy:**
  - The block confirmation copy says both directions and "They are not told", matching #610's commitment text.
  - The Unblock path is in Community safety.
  - The 13 strings checked have no exclamation marks or emoji.
- **`communityErrors.ts`:**
  - Every backend code it maps exists at #610's head; I grepped all 16.
  - The five codes whose wording comes from the server use the server's `message`.
  - 401, 403, 404/410, 409, 429 and offline each get copy that names the next step.
  - Anything else gets a reference from the response request id, the outbound request id, or a fresh UUID, plus the support address. It sends one `captureError` whose context holds only area, action, status, code, request id and reference. `Sentry.captureException` of an Axios error does not serialise `config.data` without ExtraErrorData, so no draft text is sent.
  - Coach moderation actions are no longer silent on failure.

## Findings
- **B-314-1, same root as backend B-610-1: the client's legacy wins screen is live UGC with no Report or Block.**
  - **Evidence:**
    - `MoreScreen.tsx:70-72` lists "Community", opening `CommunityScreen`.
    - `CommunityScreen.tsx:68-90` lists other members' wins (`useCommunityFeed`) and posts free text (`usePostWin`).
    - It renders no `SafetyMenu`.
    - It is not behind `featureFlags.communityTab` (`ClientNavigator.tsx:416`; only the tab at :636 is gated).
  - **Why it blocks:** an App Store reviewer can reach it with the community flag off, and there is no way to report or block there.
  - **Minimal fix:**
    - Gate the More > Community row and the `Community` stack screen behind `featureFlags.communityTab` (or remove them). This pairs with gating the backend routes.
    - Or, if the operator keeps wins, add `SafetyMenu` with a wins report target once #610 adds one.
- **C-314-1:** challenge comments have two report entries. The older flag button sends `reason: 'inappropriate'` through the challenge route (`CommunityChallengeDetailScreen.tsx:382-395`), and `SafetyMenu` sends the reason the user picked. Keep one.
- **C-314-2:** the block confirmation mentions "voice notes" while voice notes are off. This is harmless, and accurate once they ship.
- **C-314-3, follows backend C-610-1:**
  - `community.dm.blocked` shows "You cannot message this member..." to the blocker too.
  - The blocker would be better served by "You blocked this member. Unblock them in Community safety to message them."
  - This needs a separate backend code.

## Evidence
- **Local at the exact head** (heavy.sh, `jest --ci --runInBand --runTestsByPath`), the 6 test files the PR changes: **6 suites, 131 tests passed**.
- **CI at `2f7789e`, all SUCCESS:** Typecheck/lint/test, Analyze (javascript-typescript), Analyze (actions), CodeQL.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#314 @ 41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**Open Sol A/B/C: 0/4/0.** Full exact-head change and surrounding native audio/navigation/error paths reviewed independently against backend #610's current voice/wins/report/block contract; no code pushed, production action or flags changed. [Candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/314), [backend contract review](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610#issuecomment-5946246912).

### B-314-2 — Voice cannot record or play in the real app, including the moderation queue
`src/hooks/voiceRecorderPort.ts:86-121` and `components/community/voicePlaybackPort.ts:49-66` resolve unavailable adapters unless registered; an exact-head, whole-repository search finds only the registration definitions/documentation, no runtime registration caller. The composer screen provides no recorder, and Hall/detail/coach-queue players provide no playback adapter, so switching voice ON still yields unavailable recording and disabled playback; the coach cannot listen before moderation. This is not closed by tests that inject/mock players or assert a player element exists. [Recorder resolution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/hooks/voiceRecorderPort.ts#L86-L121), [playback resolution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/components/community/voicePlaybackPort.ts#L49-L66), [composer wiring](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/community/CommunityVoiceComposerScreen.tsx#L87-L105), [coach player](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/community/CoachCommunityModerationScreen.tsx#L260-L271).

Minimal fix: bundle and register real recorder/playback adapters for client and coach, with microphone permission handling, duration/size limits, cancellation/resource cleanup and actual upload/playback errors. Verify real installed-build record → upload → second member report → coach playback → hide/warn/ban → both-way block → author delete; committed integration tests must exercise production registration, not an injected available fake alone. Leaving voice dark or reducing functionality is not a resolution to the owner's reportable-and-ON launch requirement. [Current capability contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/hooks/voiceRecorderPort.ts#L1-L22).

### B-314-3 — The safety contact action fails without a visible recovery path
`screens/community/CommunitySafetyScreen.tsx:126-135` voids `Linking.openURL(mailto:...)` without handling rejection; on a device without a configured email handler the primary team/coach-safety escalation action rejects and gives no specific failure, Retry or selectable/copyable address fallback. Merely displaying the email in nonselectable Text does not make the promised recovery action work. [Email action](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/community/CommunitySafetyScreen.tsx#L120-L137).

Minimal fix: handle email-intent rejection in the rendered caller, explain that an email app could not open, keep the canonical address selectable/copyable, and offer Retry or another working contact path. Add a rejected-intent rendered-screen regression, not just a successful mailto target assertion. [Affected screen](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/community/CommunitySafetyScreen.tsx#L120-L137).

### B-314-4 — Wins-only users have no route to the promised safety/contact/unblock screen
`ClientNavigator.tsx:416` keeps More → Community wins available independently of `featureFlags.communityTab`, but CommunitySafety is registered only inside the flag-gated CommunityNavigator tab (`CommunityNavigator.tsx:66`, `ClientNavigator.tsx:636-648`). The rewritten wins screen has no safety/contact entry and SafetyMenu tells successful blockers to unblock from Community safety, which is unreachable in the supported flag-off/wins-live configuration. [Wins registration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/navigation/ClientNavigator.tsx#L409-L420), [gated navigator](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/navigation/ClientNavigator.tsx#L633-L650), [safety route](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/navigation/CommunityNavigator.tsx#L58-L70), [promised unblock](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/components/community/SafetyMenu.tsx#L132-L150).

Minimal fix: expose the real safety/contact/blocked-members screen from More/wins wherever wins are available, without cutting wins; align the backend safety availability at the same seam. Test an actual navigator with communityTab OFF: wins → safety contact, block → blocked list → unblock → restored feed, not only a mocked standalone screen. [Wins surface](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/client/CommunityScreen.tsx), [backend availability finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610#issuecomment-5946246912).

### B-314-5 — Refreshing an expired signed audio link does not replace the loaded handle
The new coach queue explicitly directs a reviewer to refresh when playback fails, but `VoiceNotePlayer.tsx:65-93` only unloads on unmount and loads a URL when `handleRef` is null. A refreshed `url` prop or playback error leaves the old handle present, so the next Play retries that stale handle rather than loading the refreshed signed URL; this affects the new long-lived 15-minute queue playback flow even after native adapters exist. [Player lifecycle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/components/community/VoiceNotePlayer.tsx#L61-L104), [queue recovery instruction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/community/CoachCommunityModerationScreen.tsx#L260-L271).

Minimal fix: key the native handle to the current URL/adapter, unload/reset on URL changes and recoverable load/play errors, and guard late async loads from resurrecting replaced/unmounted handles. Add rerender/expiry tests proving a newly signed URL is actually loaded, the old handle unloaded, and retry recovers without remounting the queue row. This is code-path evidence, not a claimed device playback execution. [Handle reuse](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/components/community/VoiceNotePlayer.tsx#L65-L93).

### Prior findings, CI and cross-PR boundary
Prior B-314-1's missing wins report/block controls are closed **in this mobile UI** by the real win target/API, own delete and draft-preserving rejection path; backend #610's remaining safety authorization defect is not thereby closed. C-314-1 duplicate challenge reporting and C-314-3 blocker-specific copy are closed; C-314-2 voice copy is consistent with the owner's new launch scope, subject to B-314-2 rather than a flag-off workaround. [Prior Opus audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/314#issuecomment-5942472172), [wins implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/client/CommunityScreen.tsx), [backend open findings](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610#issuecomment-5946246912).

All three required checks succeeded at this exact head; actual Typecheck/lint/test CI reports **404 suites / 5,432 passing tests**, including new safety-menu, voice-section, wins and coach-queue suites. No local heavy suite or native device acceptance was run; those passing mocks do not prove native recording/playback, rejected mail intent, navigator reachability or signed-link replacement. [Executed CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36968414115/job/110717082992), [JS/TS analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36968414135/job/110717083023), [Actions analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36968414135/job/110717083109).

Backend #610's storage/privacy, RLS, ban, own-deletion and durable-warning findings remain independent blockers; in particular “Warning sent” must be backed by a durable member-visible warning, not optional best-effort push. Staffed 24-hour handling and the end-to-end installed client/coach scenario remain release acceptance, not granted by this review. [Backend verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610#issuecomment-5946246912).

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#314 @ 4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**A/B/C 0/2/0. Independent T4 re-audit paired with backend #610:** prior audits/fix table read, native adapter/recording/playback/navigation/safety/error paths reviewed, including the new expo-audio package/lock/plugin. Existing B-314-2/3/4/5 and the claimed warning-copy/error-map follow-ups are addressed in code; new asynchronous native resource ownership gaps remain. [Previous Sol findings](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/314#issuecomment-5946281355), [earlier Opus findings](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/314#issuecomment-5942472172), [paired backend](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610).

**New B-314-7 — pending recorder start survives unmount; permission failures escape the UI handler.** `useVoiceRecorder:118-133,166-193` only cancels on unmount when `startedAtRef` is already populated, but populates it after awaiting permission/start; there is no mounted/generation/in-flight-start fence. Independent execution of the exact candidate hook with lightweight hook/typed-port doubles holds `recorder.start`, unmounts, then resolves it: active capture=true, cancel calls=0 and one new ticker after unmount. Separately, a rejecting permission read rejects `start` while status remains idle, because both permission awaits are outside its try; the composer invokes `void rec.start()`. The production adapter additionally enters recording audio mode before awaited prepare with no failure finally restoring it. [Hook ownership/error boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/hooks/useVoiceRecorder.ts#L118-L193), [native start](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/services/voiceAudio.ts#L193-L239), [fire-and-forget UI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/components/community/VoiceNoteComposer.tsx#L260-L272).

Minimal fix: one in-flight start authority with mounted/generation fencing across permission/audio-mode/prepare, cancellation/cleanup on retirement even before recording state, late completion disposal, and try/finally restoring playback mode after failed preparation/stop. Catch permission rejections into actionable recovery with a reported reference; add held-permission/prepare/start → unmount, rapid double start, rejected permission/prepare/stop tests through the default native adapter. This probe establishes JS ownership failure with doubles, not actual microphone capture on a real device or a claim about Expo's separate native automatic disposal. [Affected adapter and hook](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/services/voiceAudio.ts).

**New B-314-8 — two Play taps during loading adopt two handles and release only one.** `VoiceNotePlayer:81,112-150,170-173,207-217` leaves the control enabled while loading and gives concurrent loads the same generation; each sees `loadedRef=null`, creates a handle and overwrites `loadedRef` without unloading the other. Independent execution of the exact component's button callbacks with two held load promises produces loads=2, plays=[0,1], then unmount unloads only handle 1: handle 0 is orphaned and can continue audio. Accessibility `busy` does not disable the button. [Exact player ownership](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/components/community/VoiceNotePlayer.tsx#L81-L173), [enabled control](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/components/community/VoiceNotePlayer.tsx#L207-L217).

Minimal fix: synchronously single-flight load/play through a ref/operation authority (not only delayed React state), retire competing handles and disable/reject the busy action; release every created handle on failure, URL change and unmount. Add two taps before either load resolves, reversed load order, URL change and unmount while both are pending; preserve the refreshed-URL retry behavior already fixed. [Affected player](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/components/community/VoiceNotePlayer.tsx).

The independent audit-only `heavy.sh node ops/evidence/AUD-SOL-111/ugc-audio-lifecycle-probe.cjs` transpiles exact source using the backend TypeScript depot and custom lightweight hook/SDK/port doubles, with **3 of 3 required expectations failing, exit 1**; it does not link/install/run the changed mobile graph or claim a mounted React/native/device test. Source/probe/nonempty JSON/log retained under `314-q2-*`. Installed-graph CI actually ran the default native fake and missing-module coverage, but those tests check unmount after completed start and serial playback, not these held/interleaved cases. [Candidate adapter tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38/src/services/__tests__/voiceAudio.test.tsx), [executed CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37033311351/job/110925270772).

Fresh exact-head guard confirms **all three required checks completed SUCCESS**; the actual installed-graph typecheck/lint/test job ran **411 suites / 5,512 tests PASS**, including voiceAudio/default adapter, missing module, VoiceNotePlayer and recorder tests. No mobile Jest/typecheck/build was run locally against the changed graph. [Executed CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37033311351/job/110925270772), [actions analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37033311372/job/110925271214), [JS/TS analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37033311372/job/110925270944).

Native module wiring is real now (expo-audio range `~56.0.12`, lock 56.0.13, foreground-only plugin); this requires a new native EAS binary and real iOS/Android microphone/record/playback/error/report/block/device acceptance before the owner's voice launch flip. No local mobile install/test because the package graph changed, and no device acceptance claimed. The mobile pure main merge reconstructs exact tree `bf71082d...`, equal own patch IDs `739c5f24...`; a later integration delta and backend's unresolved RLS/erasure/notice defects remain separate gates. [Package/plugin changes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/314/files), [paired backend](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#314 @ 4192ba9dbff1dfc93b5ac43bc3de4b9f52747b38 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Re-audit of the community safety fix round (T4, paired with backend #610). This verdict also covers the findings I drafted at `41d829d7` but did not post.

**A0 / B2 / C0.**
- Every earlier Opus finding is closed.
- Two new resource-ownership gaps in the native audio wiring remain. I concur with Sol's B-314-7 and B-314-8 from the re-audit at this head ([5957254228](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/314#issuecomment-5957254228)).
- I reproduced B-314-8 with my own executed test.

### Earlier findings: all closed, checked in code
- **B-314-2 (no recorder or player): CLOSED.** `src/services/voiceAudio.ts` adds:
  - a real expo-audio recorder port and playback port;
  - lazy `require('expo-audio')` with a Sentry-reported fallback for binaries without the module.
  - `expo-audio ~56.0.12` is in package.json (installed 56.0.13), and the `app.json` plugin has the microphone string, with background recording and background playback off.
- **B-314-3 (rejected mailto): CLOSED.** `CommunitySafetyScreen.tsx:120-127`: a failed `openURL` moves to the `failed` state, which shows a copy-address recovery.
- **B-314-4 (Safety reachable only in the flag-gated tab): CLOSED.** `ClientNavigator.tsx:229,421` registers `CommunitySafety` in the More stack.
- **B-314-5 (stale signed URL): CLOSED.** `VoiceNotePlayer.tsx:74-97,117-120`: the loaded clip is keyed by its URL and released when the URL changes.
- **B-314-6 ("Warning sent."): CLOSED.**
  - `CoachCommunityModerationScreen.tsx:118-134`: the copy depends on `memberNotice.stored` and never claims delivery.
  - Its accuracy now depends on backend B-610-4 (Warn then Ban reports `stored: true`).
- **C-314-4 (retired `community.dm.blocked`): CLOSED.** The mapping is removed, and a contract test pins the removal.

### B — must fix
- **B-314-8 (Sol): concur, reproduced.**
  - Evidence: in `VoiceNotePlayer.tsx:112-140`, two `start()` calls during loading both see `loadedRef === null` with the same generation. Both load and both adopt; the second overwrites `loadedRef` without unloading the first.
  - The control stays enabled while loading (`:207-213`; `busy` is accessibility-only).
  - **My executed test** (`auditOpus111DoubleTap.test.tsx`, via `heavy.sh`, real component, injected port with held loads) gave `{"loads":2,"plays":[1,1],"unloads":[0,1]}`. Both clips play, and after unmount handle 0 is never released.
  - Minimal fix: keep a synchronous in-flight ref, so a second press while loading is ignored or joins the first load. On adoption, unload any handle that is not adopted. Test two taps before either load resolves, plus unmount while loading.
- **B-314-7 (Sol): concur.** The recorder start has no ownership fence and no failure recovery. There are three gaps:
  1. **No fence across unmount.**
     - `useVoiceRecorder.ts:116-125`: unmount cancels only if `startedAtRef` is set, but it is set after the awaited `recorder.start()` (`:175-179`).
     - So an unmount during start leaks a running ticker until the 5-minute cap.
     - expo-audio's `useAudioRecorder` releases the native object on unmount (`useReleasingSharedObject`, `expo-audio/build/ExpoAudio.js:225-229`), so the microphone itself is probably released. The JavaScript side is not.
  2. **Unhandled permission failure.** At `:162-166` both permission awaits are outside the try. A rejection escapes `void rec.start()`, the state stays idle, and the member is shown no message.
  3. **Recording audio mode not restored on failure.**
     - `voiceAudio.ts:202-205` switches to recording mode before `prepareToRecordAsync()` with no catch or finally.
     - `stop()` at `:217-218` skips `restorePlaybackMode()` if `recorder.stop()` throws.
     - On iOS, later voice notes then play from the earpiece.
  - Minimal fix:
    - Hold a mounted or generation ref across permission, mode and prepare, and cancel a late-finishing start.
    - Wrap the permission reads in the same try, ending in a coded error state with recovery copy.
    - Restore playback mode in a `finally` in both `start` and `stop`.
    - Tests: unmount during start, a rejected permission read, and a rejected prepare or stop restoring the mode.

### Executed evidence and checks
- **Local**, via `heavy.sh` with `CI=true npx jest --runInBand`: `VoiceNotePlayer`, `voiceAudio`, `CommunitySafetyScreen` and `communityErrorsContract` gave **29 passed**. The B-314-8 test fails as shown above (1 failed, by design).
- **CI at this exact head:** Typecheck/lint/test, Analyze (javascript-typescript) and Analyze (actions) are SUCCESS.
- The head contains mobile main `e3986e89`, and its tree `a746641c` equals the merge-tree with main.

### Release
- Shipping this needs a new native EAS binary, because expo-audio is a native module.
- The voice flag needs real iOS and Android acceptance before it is turned on: record, play, failure paths, and report or block.
- Backend #610's open B items (B-610-4/5/6/7) gate the pair.

No push, merge, dispatch or production action by this auditor.
